revert.title: REVERSION: BUY THE LAGGARD.
revert.doc: Turns the rotation around. Buys the basket's two weakest names (momentum z of -0.5 or lower) on an up bar with heavy volume, in a basket still correlated at 0.3, and sells once the name's move is no longer negative. Momentum entries lost in every setting tried; in a correlated basket the laggard catching up is the more usual trade.

revert_deep.title: REVERSION, DEEPER LAGGARDS.
revert_deep.doc: As revert, but only names at least 1.5 sigma behind.

revert_tight.title: REVERSION IN TIGHT BASKETS.
revert_tight.doc: As revert, but only in baskets correlated at 0.6 or more, where a laggard is most likely to be pulled back to the group.

revert_uptrend.title: REVERSION, DIPS IN AN UPTREND.
revert_uptrend.doc: As revert, but only in names above a rising three-session average: a dip in an uptrend rather than a name breaking down.
revert_uptrend.filter:
closes = [float(c) for c in context.closes(symbol, 105)]
    if len(closes) < 105:
        return False
    now = sum(closes[-78:]) / 78
    before = sum(closes[-104:-26]) / 78
    return closes[-1] > now > before

revert_any_bar.title: REVERSION WITHOUT THE EXPANSION GATE.
revert_any_bar.doc: As revert, but volatility expansion is not required to open. A laggard drifting quietly behind its group is still a laggard.

strict_entry.title: STRICTER MOMENTUM ENTRY.
strict_entry.doc: Momentum z of 1.5 and expansion of 1.3x to open.

one_tranche.title: ALL IN AT ONCE.
one_tranche.doc: A position is one tranche, bought whole on the first signal, rather than built in thirds on volume.

tight_trail.title: TIGHTER TRAIL.
tight_trail.doc: The trailing stop sits 2.5 ATR off the last session's high instead of 4.

wide_trail.title: WIDER TRAIL.
wide_trail.doc: The trailing stop sits 6 ATR off the last two sessions' high instead of 4 off one.

uptrend.title: UPTREND FILTER.
uptrend.doc: Opens only above a rising three-session average.
uptrend.filter:
closes = [float(c) for c in context.closes(symbol, 105)]
    if len(closes) < 105:
        return False
    now = sum(closes[-78:]) / 78
    before = sum(closes[-104:-26]) / 78
    return closes[-1] > now > before
